triage: Identify the cloud event (user creation, key creation, policy change)

Review the source IP and API caller identity
containment: Immediately revoke new access keys or tokens
eradication: Audit all IAM changes since the event
Check for privilege escalation via role chaining
Review CloudTrail/Activity Log for follow-on actions
